bpmn:process.name: Loading the vocabulary
bpmn:process.bpmn:documentation: The element sets that ship with Studyflow. The four required sets always load; the rest, one per skill, load when switched on in Settings, Extensions. The catalog compiles every loaded set into the palette, the inspector tabs, and the namespaces the XML may use. Drawn for docs/developers.qmd.
